commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a NaN fallback to `loadSessionLogs` when top-level transcript timestamps fail `Date` parsing.

PR surface: Source +1. Total +1 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main directly assigns `new Date(parsed.timestamp).getTime()` in `loadSessionLogs`, so an invalid string can produce `NaN` before the gateway sends logs. I did not run a full session-file gateway repro in this read-only review.
